threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Fluctuations in the US dollar exchange rate introduce currency risk to import costs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Global supply chain disruptions continue to cause raw material price fluctuations.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Global factors that are currently going on, based on that the price fluctuations that have come in raw material are coming, those are also coming upon global supply and the entire chain dynamics." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Bangladesh textilers are facing power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and..." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S20/W9/O28/T15), led by 'Silkflex expects to reach full capacity utilization at its plant by the end of FY27', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
